evidence.quote: If you don't have a Slack workspace already, we recommend also setting up a developer sandbox.
Now you've got everything you need to start developing on the Slack platform!
Learn how to use OAuth 2.0 to securely authenticate users and request access tokens.
Understand the different types of tokens your app can use (user tokens, bot tokens, and app tokens) and how to manage them.

result.notes: Slack Web API (REST-style) accessed via app creation on api.slack.com/docs.slack.dev; free developer sandbox/workspace lets anyone create an app and obtain OAuth bot/user tokens (xoxb-/xoxp-) sent as Bearer tokens. No official Slack-published MCP server found; several high-star community MCP servers exist (korotovsky/slack-mcp-server, tuannvm/slack-mcp-client, slackapi/slack-skills-plugin). Some admin-level endpoints (Enterprise Grid) require additional approval, but core Web API is self-serve.
result.one_liner: Slack is a team messaging and collaboration platform with channels, DMs, and a large app/bot ecosystem.
